author: TeIq
content: Delivered: 5 repository modules (subject, incident, action, report, observation) under polaris-backend/src/repo/, each exposing a Repo trait + PgImpl + New<Type> input type. RepoError thiserror enum with SQLSTATE-routed variants (UniqueViolation 23505, ForeignKey 23503, AppendOnlyViolation P0001). AFIT-based async fn in trait per dispatch directive. polaris-types enum-to-DB string mapping via existing as_str/from_wire methods on each type. ObservationKind serialized via (discriminator, payload) split into kind TEXT + evidence JSONB columns and reconstructed on read. tests/repo_roundtrip.rs round-trips Subject/Incident/Action/Report/Observation with cross-aggregate FK chain. tests/actions_append_only.rs proves the BEFORE UPDATE trigger raises SQLSTATE P0001 AND the row is unchanged AND RepoError::AppendOnlyViolation is the routed variant. 15 new .sqlx/ cache entries committed. AC-8 invariant intact (polaris-types still has zero proto-blue dependency).
